login.added: {domain} added. Create the TXT record and verify
login.domainsDescription: Employees who sign in with an email on a verified domain automatically become members of the organisation with the default role, without an invitation. Ownership is proved with a DNS TXT record. Public email providers (gmail.com etc.) cannot be used.
login.noDomains: No domains yet. Add your email domain to turn on auto-join.
login.policyTitle: Microsoft Entra ID and login policy
login.microsoftOff: Microsoft sign-in is not enabled on this installation yet. Auto-join on verified domains still works with regular sign-in with a verified email, but tenant binding and "SSO only" require Microsoft sign-in. Contact support.
login.tenantHelp: Found in the Azure portal under Microsoft Entra ID → Overview. Once set, auto-join requires the user to be signed in with Microsoft from exactly this tenant. The email domain alone is not enough.
login.tenantWarning: Strongly recommended. Without a tenant ID, Microsoft sign-in does not count as proof of the email. Only users with a verified email (e.g. Google or a confirmation link) can auto-join. With a tenant ID, employees can sign in directly with Microsoft, and accounts from other tenants are rejected.
login.roleHelp: New members get an employee profile without a department. Managers and administrators are assigned afterwards under Employees.
login.roleManagerWarning: All new users on the domain become managers with access to team data and approvals. Only choose this if the whole domain consists of managers.
login.requireSso: Require Microsoft sign-in for verified domains ("SSO only")
login.requireSsoHelp: Blocks sign-in and sign-up with email/password and magic link for users on your verified domains, including Google/GitHub/Discord and phone. Passkeys are still allowed. Requires Microsoft sign-in to be enabled and at least one domain to be verified.
login.connectMicrosoft: <link>Connect Microsoft to your own account</link> first, otherwise you will lock yourself out.
login.require2fa: Require two-step verification for managers, HR and administrators
login.require2faHelp: Without 2FA, managers/administrators can still log their own time, but cannot approve, view team data or change settings.
login.enable2fa: <link>Enable 2FA on your own account</link> before you turn the requirement on.
login.title: Login & domains

compliance.rule48hDesc: Average weekly working time over the reference period must not exceed 48 hours.
compliance.dailyRestDesc: At least 11 consecutive hours of rest per 24 hours. Without times of day, the daily total is used (over 13 hours in a day).
compliance.weeklyRestDesc: At least one consecutive rest day per week. Approved absence days count as rest.
compliance.saveFailed: Could not save the compliance settings
compliance.title: Compliance (Working Time Act)
compliance.intro: The rules are checked on every entry (timesheet, manual time, check-out) and when the week is submitted. Self-scheduling employees (§2) are exempt. See the <link>compliance overview</link> for violations per employee.

break.noneDesc: Breaks are not recorded in the system.
break.paidLabel: Paid break included in standard hours
break.paidDesc: The employee logs the whole day including the break (e.g. 8 h). No deduction. The break is only shown for documentation.
break.unpaidLabel: Unpaid break deducted on check-in/out over 6 h
break.unpaidDesc: When the day's presence via check-in/out is over 6 hours, the break is deducted from the logged hours. Timesheet cells are not touched.

work.saveFailed: Could not save working hours and breaks
work.dailyRange: Daily standard must be 0.5-24 hours (or empty)
work.breakNeeded: Enter the break length in minutes when a break policy is selected
work.title: Working hours and breaks
work.weeklyHelp: Used as a suggestion for new employees and as the basis for scaling the daily standard for part-time.
work.dailyHelp: Empty = weekly hours / working days. Set e.g. 8.0 if a paid break is included in the working day. Part-time is scaled automatically.
work.dailyHelpExample: Empty = weekly hours / working days. Set e.g. 8.0 if a paid break is included in the working day. Part-time is scaled automatically (30 h/week → {value} h/day).
work.footnote: Changes apply from the next calculation. Employees can get their own daily standard and break under Employees → Edit.

rules.saveFailed: Could not save the timesheet rules
rules.maxRange: Max hours per day must be 1-24
rules.lockRange: Rolling lock must be 0-104 whole weeks (or empty)
rules.title: Timesheet rules
rules.maxHelp: Days with more hours cannot be submitted.
rules.lockHelp: E.g. 2: employees cannot edit entries older than 2 whole weeks. Managers and administrators are exempt. Empty = no lock.
rules.autoLockHelp: E.g. Wednesday: from Wednesday employees cannot edit the previous week. Managers and administrators are exempt.
rules.warnOverNorm: Warn on submit when a day or the week is over standard hours
rules.warnOverNormHelp: The employee can still submit after confirming.
rules.blockEmpty: Block submit on empty working days without absence or public holiday
rules.blockEmptyHelp: Off: empty working days only give a warning.

absenceTypes.categoryHelp: Sickness and leave can be registered without an end date.

absenceTypes.updateFailed: Could not update the absence type
absenceTypes.deleteFailed: Could not delete the absence type
absenceTypes.capRange: Cap per year must be 0.5-365 days
absenceTypes.title: Absence types

activity.saveFailed: Could not save the activity type
activity.title: Activity types
activity.intro: Employees log time per activity under a project in the timesheet (e.g. teaching, preparation, meetings). The pay code is included in the payroll report details. Without activity types, the timesheet has one row per project.
activity.billableInfo: Billable determines whether new entries on the activity are billable. Time on an internal client is always non-billable, and "Inherit" uses the default (timesheet: non-billable).

vacation.saveFailed: Could not save the holiday settings
vacation.title: Holiday year and accrual
vacation.balanceKept: The balance is kept per {range}. Only change this at the start of a holiday year. Existing periods are not changed.
vacation.upfront: The whole pool at the start of the holiday year
vacation.monthlyHelp: Ongoing accrual (concurrent holiday) is posted on the 1st of the month for the previous month, scaled by the employee's weekly hours. Extra holiday days are always granted at the start of the holiday year.
vacation.switchWarning: Switching mid holiday year: employees' remaining days are not carried over automatically. Run the switch script (set-org-vacation-settings, see docs/solutions/ferie-modelskift) to move the remainder as an opening balance.
vacation.carryOverHelp: The Danish Holiday Act allows carrying over up to 5 days by agreement. The year-end run is automatic for organisations with ongoing accrual.
vacation.payOut: Pay out the remainder above the cap
vacation.payOutHelp: Otherwise days above the carry-over cap are forfeited when the holiday year ends.

org.saveFailed: Could not save the organisation settings
org.title: Organisation
org.name: Organisation name
org.overtimeHelp: Hours above the threshold are moved from flex to the overtime balance when a week is approved.
org.overdraftHelp: Holiday beyond the balance is rejected unless the negative balance is within the tolerance. A yellow warning is shown instead.

payroll.title: Payroll and pay codes
payroll.description: Payroll system, payroll period, pay codes and mapping rules (activity, absence, overtime → pay code), employee numbers and export of the payroll period as a flat file for the payroll system.

loginBox.title: Login, domains and data processing agreement
loginBox.description: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in with automatic association of employees on your verified email domains, tenant binding, SSO and two-step verification requirements, and the data processing agreement (GDPR art. 28).

import.title: Data import
import.description: Bring history over from your old system. Employees are matched by email, projects are created automatically, and the import can be tested without writing anything.

flexNorm.saveFailed: Could not save the norm period
flexNorm.annualRange: The annual norm must be 1-4000 hours (or empty)
flexNorm.title: Norm period and flex
flexNorm.presetStandardDesc: The norm is the employee's daily norm (37 h/week full-time) or work plan, and the balance is settled every week.
flexNorm.presetTeachersDesc: The norm period is the school year (1/8–31/7) with an annual norm of 1,924 h full-time. Holiday, public holidays and other absence are deducted.
flexNorm.presetHint: Fills in the fields below. Remember to save.
flexNorm.annualHint: E.g. 1924. Multiplied by the employment rate and spread over the working days.
flexNorm.carryMax: Cap on plus balance at carry-over (hours)
flexNorm.carryDeficit: Cap on minus balance at carry-over (hours)
flexNorm.startHint: Empty = from the start of the current period.
flexNorm.carryHint: At the end of the period the balance is carried over to the next period. Anything above the cap is cut off. 0 = the balance is reset.

closing.saveFailed: Could not save the period closing
closing.title: Period closing
closing.intro: At the end of the period a statement is created per employee (logged, norm, flex and absence). The manager approves, the employee acknowledges, and the period is locked. Only an administrator can unlock, and the reason is logged.

groupDesc.timesheet: Submitted, approved, rejected and reopened — and period closing (statement, approval, acknowledgement)
groupDesc.absence: Requests, decisions, registrations and sick reports
groupDesc.reminder: Friday reminder when the timesheet is missing, and (optionally) when yesterday's utilisation was low
groupDesc.compliance: Warnings about working time rules on submission (to managers)

notif.webhookSavedHint: Send a test message to confirm the connection.
notif.escalationInvalid: Escalation must be a whole number of days (at least 1)
notif.title: Notifications
notif.intro: Defaults for the whole organisation. Employees can adjust email, push and in-app themselves in their own settings. Teams is controlled here only.
notif.teamsNote: Teams only receives manager events (submitted timesheets, requests, sick reports, working time warnings and digest), never messages to the individual employee.
notif.teamsInfo: Create an Incoming Webhook in Teams (Power Automate: "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received") and paste the URL here. It is only stored on the server and is never shown in full again.
notif.digestInfo: A combined overview for managers of missing timesheets and pending requests in their department. Administrators get the whole organisation and items are marked as escalated when something has waited longer than the limit.
